metadata.title: Clicked like a confused squirrel and somehow two enemies vanished? Valorant logic broke again
metadata.description:
Tapping like I was aiming at a snack
Two unlucky souls probably rethinking their life choices
Did NOT deserve that accidental double scare but hey, chaos is free
Hit if your aim’s more accidental magic than skill!

Tap if your aim’s mostly ‘wait, what just happened?’ moments!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
